ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Retailer acquisition, Range review and later stages need Samples status and Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Retailer_acquisition", CASE(StageName, "Identified", 1, "Contacted", 2, "Line sheet sent", 3, "Range review", 4, "Terms discussion", 5, "Account setup", 6, "Account opened", 7, 0) >= 4, OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Samples_status__c)), ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Samples status and Next step date before moving to Range review.
